title: Normal and periodic tracking area updating procedure initiation

entities.name: Tracking Area Updating Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE in EMM-REGISTERED state to update tracking area information with MME. Can be normal or periodic updating.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to initiate tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state where tracking area updating procedure can be initiated.

entities.name: EMM-TRACKING-AREA-UPDATING-INITIATED
entities.description: UE state entered after sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

entities.name: T3430
entities.description: Timer started when UE sends TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

entities.name: T3412
entities.description: Periodic tracking area updating timer whose expiration triggers procedure initiation.

entities.name: EPS update type
entities.description: IE indicating type of update: periodic updating or TA updating.

entities.name: UE radio capability information update needed
entities.description: IE included when UE radio capability changes.

entities.name: Old GUTI
entities.description: IE containing previous GUTI or mapped GUTI from P-TMSI/RAI.

entities.name: Current TAI not in TAI list
entities.description: Condition triggering tracking area updating when UE detects current TAI is not in registered TAI list.

entities.name: T3412 timer expires
entities.description: Condition triggering periodic tracking area updating.

entities.name: Integrity protection required
entities.description: Property requiring TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST to be integrity protected with current EPS security context.

relations.description: Procedure initiated by sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
Procedure can only be initiated when UE is in EMM-REGISTERED state.
Sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST causes UE to enter EMM-TRACKING-AREA-UPDATING-INITIATED state.
Sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST starts timer T3430.
Condition where current TAI not in list triggers procedure initiation.
Condition where T3412 expiration triggers periodic updating procedure.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST contains EPS update type IE.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST contains UE radio capability information update needed IE when radio capability changes.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST contains Old GUTI IE.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST requires integrity protection with current EPS security context.
